archetypes.name: dyn-closure-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: The change alters closure ratchet failure semantics and tier movement handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the closure-growth violation logic. Focus on whether dropped baseline files fail for the selected target while legitimate eager/conditional tier moves remain allowed. Check that review conditional metric ratcheting is not weakened beyond the intended tier-move exception. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
